image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of an ornate vintage-style necklace against a plain white background. The necklace features a central gold-toned heart-shaped locket with an engraved floral design. Above the locket is a decorative band composed of pink oval cabochon stones set in intricate metal filigree, interspersed with faceted clear/grey beads and smaller pink pearls. The chain extends outwards towards the top corners, showing linked construction.
